mainline: Macro observations -> effective state and response environment -> conditional risk -> matched-input forecast evaluation

evidence_types.model: Fixed simulated response cells; 32 origins x 128 paired future branches per cell. Capacity is latent model capacity, not measured book depth.
evidence_types.source_diagnosis: 256 model origins, independent simulation replicates; 128/64/64 fit/tune/test. Hidden environment includes activity, sizes, capacity and weight concentration.
evidence_types.market: Observed BTCUSDT-derived aggregates. 32 past five-minute bars of signed flow, volume, count and return; next 12 squared log returns at UTC noon. 401 previously seen internal evaluation dates; no external confirmation.

findings.capacity: At feedback 0.15, common-innovation correlation 0.65 versus 0 adds 3.306, 2.230, 1.639e-6 to mean risk at normalized capacity 0.5, 1, 1.5; these increments are 7.44%, 6.42%, 5.42% of the respective common-signal-arm risk. These are simulated conditional effects.
findings.interaction: The tested common-signal/feedback interaction is subadditive; this grid does not establish universal saturation or safe feedback.
findings.precision: Same-law conditional moment integration reduces simulation noise. Remaining state variation in the intervention contrast is real, but intervention contrast is not incremental forecast information.
findings.information: The tested hidden environment block improves source-risk prediction. Tested additional direction/memory information does not establish incremental QLIKE improvement.
findings.market: Development-selected HAR+Components QLIKE 0.501501 versus HAR-All 0.532309: 5.79% point reduction, paired difference CI crosses zero, Holm p=0.33. Same fields/history/real calibration; structural priors and representations differ.
findings.controls: Post-run descriptive HAR+RV20 0.502745 and HAR+RawMoments20 0.499219 nearly reproduce or exceed the selected result. They did not replace the primary selection or receive a new primary significance claim.
findings.identity: Only the chi=1, constant local noise, activity-forecast-off, no-fallback limit equals 12*(alpha^2+mean20((r-alpha)^2)); this is not the full activity-forecast model.

limitations: No unique inversion of real coordinating participants or funds.
No accepted additional mechanism-specific forecast advantage.
No identification of observed book liquidity or a regulatory optimum.
verification: verify.py reconstructs published saved-table effects and QLIKE scores and validates hashes. It does not regenerate simulation paths, source calibration or market fits.
